description: This file defines the ValidatorException class used for exception handling within the validation component of the OrangeHRM API v2. It extends the base Exception class, providing a default error message and custom constructor.

classes.name: ValidatorException
classes.description: Custom exception class for validation errors within the OrangeHRM API v2, extending the base PHP Exception class and providing a default error message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for ValidatorException that sets the error message, code, and previous exception, with a default message if none is provided.
